props.name: Oak
props.desc: Broad round-canopied shade oak, 11 m.

props.name: Golden Driller
props.desc: 76-ft gold statue of an oil worker in a hard hat, right hand resting on a derrick, Expo Square.

props.name: Street Lamp
props.desc: Galvanised cobra-head street light; arm reaches 2.5 m toward +y (the road).

props.name: Dumpster
props.desc: Green front-load dumpster with black lids.

props.name: Blue Whale of Catoosa
props.desc: Route 66 roadside icon: 24 m smiling blue whale with an open walk-in mouth, white hat and raised tail, sitting in its pond with a plank walkway to the mouth.

props.name: Praying Hands
props.desc: 18 m bronze praying hands sculpture (palms pressed, fingertips up, shirt cuffs) on a granite pedestal at the ORU entrance. Thumbs face +y.

props.name: Prayer Tower
props.desc: 60 m mid-century tower at ORU: finned white shaft, gold glass observation deck ringed with a crown of spikes, spire and eternal flame (emissive).

props.name: Center of the Universe
props.desc: Small concentric brick circle downtown with an acoustic centre disc; walk-through ground piece.

props.name: Space Cowboy Statue
props.desc: 6 m fiberglass Route 66 'space cowboy' giant: bubble helmet, red shirt, jeans, boots, holding a toy rocket (original take on Buck Atom).

props.name: Dairy Neon Sign
props.desc: Fictional rooftop-style 'MILK' neon sign on a small open pavilion (stand-in for the Route 66 dairy sign at 11th & Lewis). Neon letters and border glow at night.

props.name: Giant Gas Pump
props.desc: Route 66 roadside giant: ~20 m vintage gas pump with a lit globe, dial face and hose (Sapulpa).

props.name: Route 66 Rising
props.desc: Arched road-ribbon sculpture with towering '66' numerals over the old Route 66 (East 11th St).

props.name: Oil Derrick
props.desc: 30 m steel lattice drilling derrick on a drill floor with crown block and doghouse.

props.name: Pumpjack
props.desc: Nodding-donkey oil pumpjack (~8 m). 4-frame loop: f0..f3 = crank at 0/90/180/270 degrees.

props.name: Farm Windmill
props.desc: Old steel farm water-pumping windmill on a lattice tower; 2-frame fan spin (f0, f1).

props.name: Water Tower
props.desc: Generic town water tower: bulb tank on four braced legs with a catwalk (label-free).

props.name: Grain Elevator
props.desc: Concrete grain elevator: 2x3 cluster of tall silos with a headhouse and roof gallery.

props.name: Oil Storage Tank

props.name: Radio Tower
props.desc: 40 m red-and-white triangular lattice radio mast with aviation beacons (emissive).

props.name: Cell Tower
